card.title: Director of Quality Engineering
card.description:
The Director of Quality Engineering – Automation & Performance is the senior technical, delivery, and practice leader for iLAB U.S. Automation and Performance Testing. The role is accountable for the day-to-day management of U.S. engineering initiatives and resources, while also providing hands-on consulting leadership for strategic clients.

This leader defines the practice strategy, architecture, standards, delivery assurance, reusable solutions, and capability roadmap for Automation and Performance Testing. Working as part of a global delivery organization, they combine technical credibility, client leadership, people management, and commercial judgment to deliver measurable quality outcomes, strengthen service offerings, and build scalable engineering capability.

* Own the day-to-day delivery, prioritization, staffing, allocation, utilization, performance, and technical direction of all iLAB U.S. Automation and Performance Testing initiatives and resources.
* Define and evolve Automation and Performance Testing strategies, capability roadmaps, service offerings, architectures, standards, frameworks, methods, tools, reusable accelerators, and intellectual property.
* Oversee technical assurance across high-impact deliveries, including solution architecture, automation and performance engineering design, CI/CD integration, AI-enabled engineering guardrails, test-data readiness, and environment readiness.
* Lead critical client-facing activities, including technical discovery, project kickoffs, solutioning workshops, executive presentations, steering reviews, escalations, and project recovery.
* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex or at-risk engagements and personally provide architecture, assessment, technical review, troubleshooting, and recovery leadership until delivery is stabilized.
* Lead the technical development and review of RFIs, RFPs, proposals, SOWs, estimates, staffing models, assumptions, deliverables, risks, acceptance criteria, and service commitments
* Establish and oversee practical engineering governance, including quality gates, code and architecture reviews, documentation standards, source-control practices, repository security, and technical approval processes.
* Define and guide responsible, value-focused uses of AI within Automation and Performance Testing, including test design assistance, script development and maintenance, results analysis, defect insight, and knowledge retrieval, while applying company security, privacy, data-handling, and human-review requirements
* Hire, coach, develop, and retain engineering managers, architects, principal engineers, and technical specialists; establish competency expectations, career paths, succession plans, and backup coverage for critical capabilities.
* Collaborate with global delivery leaders to align technical standards, share reusable assets and expertise, and support other geographies with strategic client and delivery needs.
* Partner with Sales, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, and Talent Management on capacity planning, forecasting, utilization, delivery margin and growth opportunities.
* Represent iLAB as a Quality Engineering thought leader through conferences, industry events, client advisory councils, publications, demonstrations, and market-facing content.

* At least 15 years of progressive experience in Quality Engineering, including senior leadership of complex Automation and Performance Testing solutions, consulting engagements, engineering teams, and CxO-level client relationships
* Deep knowledge of Automation and Performance Testing strategies, architectures, frameworks, tools, workload models, execution practices, analysis, reporting, and integration with modern software delivery pipelines
* Experience leading technical delivery across multiple clients, programs, or business units, including distributed teams and critical project recovery.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD integration, testability, observability, test-data and environment readiness, cloud delivery, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
* Proven people leadership, including resource planning, coaching, performance management, prioritization, utilization, and organizational development.
* Strong consulting and client-advisory skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions and delivery plans.
* Experience shaping proposals, SOWs, estimates, resource models, and commercial commitments.
* Sound understanding of consulting engagement economics, including forecasting, utilization, margin, cost-to-serve, and measurable client outcomes.
* A mature, politically astute leadership style; calm in a crisis, able to lead by influence and example, with excellent written and oral communication.
* Willing and able to travel interstate and occasionally internationally for critical client-facing initiatives, project kickoffs, workshops, presentations, escalations, and recovery efforts.
* Demonstrated experience in a Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Automation, or Performance Testing consulting or professional-services organization.
* Experience across the consulting lifecycle and multi-country delivery teams; relevant industry expertise and advanced professional certifications are beneficial.

card.description:
**Company****:**
================

AHI agilon health, inc.

**Job Posting Location****:**
=============================

Remote - USA

**Job Title****:**
==================

Regional Director, Operations

**Job Description****:**
========================

***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.***

The Regional Director of Operations has end-to-end operational accountability for planning, execution, and continuous improvement of market-level Risk Adjustment (BOI), Quality (HEDIS) and Cost of Care operation programs across multiple markets. This role owns operational processes, staffing, budgets, vendor relationships, data and technology enablement, and performance outcomes. The Director partners with platform BOI/Quality, Market Medical Directors, IT/Engineering, Data & Analytics, Finance and RBEs/providers to deliver compliant, scalable, and measurable operational performance.

*This role requires travel 4–10 days per month to visit partner groups*

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Operational Leadership & Execution – 45%**

* Lead and operationalize BOI, Quality and Cost of Care programs across 3+ markets; develop and enforce SOPs, SLAs and RACI for all program activities.
* Collaborate with Central Operations to manager operation, performance and outcomes related to pre-visit record review, post-visit coding review, chart collection, query workflows and provider engagement processes.
* In close partnership with the Market Leader and market operations team, oversee market operations, monitor performance, and implement corrective action and performance improvement plans.
* Define operational KPIs, run root cause analysis, lead process improvement efforts and institutionalize best practices across markets.
* Serve as the escalation point for market operational issues and lead cross-functional readiness for new initiatives.
* Provide oversight of operating budgets for BOI/Quality (labor, contractors, vendor spend); forecast resource needs and identify cost-to-serve improvements.

**Data & Technology Ownership – 35%**

* Partner with Data & Analytics and IT/Engineering to define technical requirements, data pipelines, EMR/claims integrations, and dashboards to support risk capture and quality improvement.
* In partnership with Tech, innovate on and participate in testing of solutions that drive automation and technology enablement to reduce manual effort and increase operational scale.

**People & Capacity – 20%**

* In collaboration with and informed by input from the Regional President, lead capacity planning, staffing models, recruitment, training and performance management for market BOI/Quality operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Minimum Experience:**

* 5+ years healthcare operations experience; 3+ years leading multi-market risk adjustment or quality programs

**Education/Licensure:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
* Six Sigma/Lean certification preferred

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Solid knowledge of HEDIS, risk adjustment coding and healthcare data (claims/EMR)
* Demonstrated management of operational teams and vendor partners
* Analytics fluency (dashboards/KPI’s and either direct SQL or close collaboration with analytics teams)
* Proven program and project management skills and process improvement experience
* *Language Skills:* Strong communication skills both written and verbal to work with multiple internal and external clients in a fast-paced environment
* *Mathematical Skills:* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
* *Reasoning Ability:* Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
* *Computer Skills:* Ability to create and maintain documents using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)

**Essential Physical Functions:**

These are requirements normally expected to perform regular job duties. Incumbent must be able to successfully perform all the functions of the job with or without accommodation.

Protect yourself: agilon health will never send unsolicited job offers or request payments or financial information. Such communications are fraudulent. Learn how to spot them

**Location****:**
=================

Remote - ME

**Pay Range****:**
==================

$129,700.00 - $162,100.00

Salary range shown is a guideline. Individual compensation packages can vary based on factors unique to each candidate, such as skill set, experience, and qualifications.

card.title: Sr. Director, Operations Excellence
card.description:
**About Prime Data Centers**

Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership.

**About the role**

The Sr. Director, Operations Excellence reports to the VP, Business Operations and leads the company's continuous improvement and process standardization strategy. This role owns the governance framework underpinning the PMO function and leads the Sr. Manager, PMO, ensuring a consistent approach to initiative delivery across the business.

The Sr. Director, Operations Excellence partners cross-functionally with other business units to extend improvement methodologies into construction workflows, and serves as a key advisor to the VP, Business Operations on operational performance and initiative prioritization.

**What you'll do**

**Operational Strategy & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and lead the enterprise continuous improvement strategy, driving process standardization and efficiency across Business Operations
* Establish methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or similar) for identifying and executing improvement initiatives
* Own the governance framework underpinning the PMO function

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop the PMO function, including portfolio governance, playbooks, training, and change management execution
* Partner with other internal functions to extend improvement methodologies into system and process workflows

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with IT, Data, Business Transformation and other functional leaders to align improvement priorities with business goals
* Serve as a key advisor to the VP, Business Operations on operational performance and initiative prioritization

**Performance Management**

* Define and track KPIs measuring the effectiveness of improvement initiatives across the organization
* Present initiative outcomes and operational performance updates to senior leadership

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree required
* 10+ years of experience in operations, process improvement, or program management, including people leadership experience
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a PMO or governance function
* Strong executive presence and communication skills
* Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional and matrixed teams

**Preferred**

* MBA or other advanced degree
* Lean/Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt)
* Experience in construction, real estate, or infrastructure industries

**Benefits**

* Comp - $230,700 - $304,700 along with an annual performance bonus
* 401k up to a 4% employer match that is fully vested upon enrollment
* 100% employee premiums paid by employer for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability
* Paid Time Off + Sick time

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants are considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, protected veteran or military status, disability status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

**Bagel Brands is the parent company for your favorite breakfast brands, Einstein Bros. Bagels, Bruegger's Bagels, Noah's NY Bagels, and Manhattan Bagel. We believe in the bagel and how it has the unique ability to bring people together. Our team has a standard set of values and behaviors that allow us to spread a little more joy and happiness in the world. They let us laugh, smile, and enjoy each other’s company a little more. These are the behaviors that guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we treat our guests. We believe that there is no better way to make someone’s day than with a warm, fresh-baked bagel and a heart-felt good morning.**

**POSITION MISSION**

The Director, Operations Excellence leads the strategy, team, and discipline that make it easier for our bakery teams to obsess over our guests and deliver great results every day. This role owns the enterprise operations engineering agenda for Bagel Brands — evaluating how work gets done, designing better ways of working, and building the team needed to test, scale, and sustain change across Field Operations and Support Center teams.

 

In alignment with Bagel Brands’ Mission, Vision, and Values, this role builds an organization that helps teams Take Ownership of better ways of working, Support Each Other through thoughtful change, and ultimately creates simpler, more consistent operations that allow bakery teams to Obsess Over Our Guests.

 
 

Department: Operations

Salary: $180,000 to $200,000

Annual Bonus: 20%

Long Term Incentive Plan: $30,000

 

**RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

**Strategic Leadership & Vision**

* Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Operations Excellence, aligning priorities with enterprise strategy and Field Operations needs.

* Build and prioritize a portfolio of process engineering and continuous improvement initiatives across the bakery system.

* Represent Operations Excellence in senior leadership and strategic planning forums, translating field findings into enterprise decisions.

 
 

**Operations Excellence & Process Engineering**

* Oversee evaluation of bakery processes, workflows, and systems to simplify work, optimize labor investments, reduce waste, and strengthen performance.

* Guide application of Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, and root-cause analysis across a portfolio of concurrent initiatives.

* Own the standard for future-state process design, balancing efficiency, guest experience, team member experience, and financial impact.

* Ensure the team produces process maps, standard work, and tools that translate solutions into repeatable bakery practices at scale.

 
 

**Testing, Piloting & Continuous Improvement**

* Set the standard for how the organization designs and governs operational pilots before broader rollout.

* Review pilot results with senior leadership and make scale, refine, or discontinue recommendations.

* Sponsor root-cause analysis on significant recurring challenges, ensuring solutions are sustainable rather than short-term fixes.

 
 

**Labor and Inventory Analytics and Systems Optimization**

* Create and maintain regular reporting for Ops teams that highlights opportunities for improvement

 
 

**Project & Change Management**

* Own the portfolio of cross-functional operational excellence initiatives from problem identification through sustainment.

* Set the organization’s approach to structured change management and ensure it is applied consistently.

* Maintain enterprise-level visibility to portfolio progress, risks, and business impact.

 
 

**Team & Field Leadership**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of Operations Excellence managers and professionals.

* Coach the team on problem solving, project management, and change leadership, building bench strength for future roles.

* Maintain regular presence in bakeries, partnering with Field Operations leaders to test and validate solutions.

* Identify successful practices within the bakery system and lead efforts to standardize and scale them.

card.description:
**Market Director of Operations**

**Coverage Area: Kansas (KC, Laurence, Overland Park) and Iowa (Davenport and Des Moines)**

**Job Summary**

The Market Director is a key operational leader responsible for the performance of a geographic network of BHG treatment centers. This role directly leads and develops Program Directors and, through those leaders, is accountable for the operational, clinical, financial, and team performance of each treatment center within the market.

This is an opportunity for an experienced multi-site healthcare leader who enjoys developing people, improving performance, solving complex operational challenges, and expanding access to high-quality patient care.

The Market Director is accountable for building a high-performing market that delivers exceptional patient care, operational excellence, strong leadership, and sustainable growth. The Market Director will also perform duties within the scope of their license or certification when applicable, as outlined in an addendum to this job description.

**What You’ll Be Accountable For**

As Market Director, you will:

* Build high-performing leaders and create a culture of accountability.
* Deliver strong operational execution and financial performance.
* Ensure outstanding patient outcomes and timely access to care.
* Maintain regulatory excellence and operational integrity.
* Drive sustainable growth through referrals and community engagement.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**

**Leadership Development**

* Mentor, coach, and develop high-performing Program Directors and other market leaders.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Build an engaged, patient-centered culture across treatment centers.
* Strengthen team member retention and develop succession plans for key leadership roles.
* Identify and develop future leaders within the organization.

**Clinical Excellence**

Partner with the Group Vice President and clinical leadership to improve and optimize key areas of clinical performance, including:

* True Counseling.
* Time to First Dose.
* Dose Stabilization.
* Patient Retention.
* Regulatory readiness.
* Patient outcomes.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure consistent execution of the BHG operating model across treatment centers.
* Optimize patient access, admissions, and census growth.
* Improve operational efficiency and labor productivity.
* Identify and remove barriers impacting treatment center performance.
* Establish and reinforce best practices across the market.
* Use performance data to identify opportunities and drive meaningful improvement.

**Patient Care & Clinical Excellence**

* Improve patient outcomes and the overall patient experience.
* Increase patient satisfaction.
* Ensure timely access to treatment.
* Support clinical quality initiatives.
* Promote a culture where patient-centered care remains at the heart of operational decisions.

**Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* Maintain a strong culture of regulatory compliance and operational integrity.
* Ensure treatment centers are prepared for DEA, accreditation, and other regulatory inspections.
* Reinforce adherence to policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and minimize operational and compliance risks.
* Partner closely with Clinical and Regulatory leadership.

**Workforce Excellence**

Partner with Talent, Performance & Workforce Strategy to ensure:

* Appropriate staffing levels across the market.
* Effective onboarding of new team members and leaders.
* Ongoing leadership development.
* Strong employee engagement.
* Improved retention and workforce stability.

**How You’ll Lead**

Successful Market Directors at BHG:

* Lead with integrity and sound judgment.
* Maintain a strong, visible presence in the field.
* Develop people and build strong leadership teams.
* Make timely, thoughtful decisions.
* Set clear expectations and hold teams accountable.
* Build trust across all levels of the organization.
* Identify and remove barriers to success.
* Balance strategy with disciplined execution.
* Never compromise patient care.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first year, you will have:

* Built a high-performing team of Program Directors.
* Increased patient access through stronger admissions and census growth.
* Improved clinical quality and patient outcomes.
* Strengthened employee engagement and retention.
* Improved operational and financial performance.
* Established a culture of accountability and consistent execution.
* Identified and developed future leaders.
* Helped position BHG as the nation’s leading provider of outpatient opioid treatment.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* Demonstrated success leading multi-site healthcare operations through transformational change and organizational growth.
* Experience managing treatment or healthcare services across economically and culturally diverse communities.
* Strong understanding of healthcare industry dynamics.
* An operational and clinical excellence mindset, with the ability to adapt to changing market conditions.
* Proven ability to inspire, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
* Ability to think strategically about growth while remaining highly engaged in day-to-day operational execution.
* Strong financial and P&L acumen.
* Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships within treatment centers and across the broader organization and community.
* High integrity and sound judgment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Disclaimer**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by team members assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Team members may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed, and this job description may be updated at any time.

BHG is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer providing equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Date Posted: Nov 11, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

At A&M, the North American Data and AI team, IQx (Official name to be announced) SBU is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. Come be part of the launch of this cutting-edge team that is making an impact on A&M’s future. Join us in making a difference.

We are seeking a Operations Director to join our team. This position is an internal role within A&M’s IQx operations team, reporting directly to the COO and Finance lead for IQx.

We value a healthy work-life balance and promote in-person collaboration by providing a flexible remote work arrangement with select days in the office, as needed. Ideal office locations are New York City or Philadelphia, but this is flexible.

We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and building leadership skills. Our business is committed to each team member’s development, training, and exposure to business leaders.

**How you will contribute**

As an Operationsirector, your primary responsibility will be for program management, resource management, onboarding activities, supporting the growth for our business, and helping us thrive to achieve our goals. The Operations Director is expected to grow to support the operations functions of the IQx business more broadly. Your primary responsibilities as we launch will include:

* Lead program management for IQx, including planning, tracking, and driving to completion the initiatives that support the launch and growth of the business
* Support and drive internal initiatives, coordinating across stakeholders, managing timelines and deliverables, and reporting progress to leadership
* Establish and run IQx meeting cadences (e.g., leadership, staffing, and pipeline reviews), including agendas, materials, action tracking, and follow-up
* Help set up and scale the IQx practice, building the operating processes, tools, and governance that will support the team as it grows
* Go-to person for all staffing matters for our business unit
* Assess and plan future resource requirements, driving utilization based on a thorough understanding of current and future project pipeline.
* Build relationships across the business with internal stakeholders including Senior Management, Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance and Operations teams
* Effectively plan for, and advise on conflicts and issues, on a regular basis, prioritizing based on commercial needs and key skills available
* Build awareness of individuals’ performance goals and development needs, influencing resourcing decisions that further the continuation of business and individuals’ skill-set development
* Advanced use of staffing/ workforce planning tools, AI and reporting (for example Profinda, Claude, PowerBI) in measuring utilization and influencing staffing decisions
* Collaborate extensively with the wider Resource Management teams across North America and globally, as required by project needs

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
--------------------------------------------

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 
 
 

**Local Study Operations Manager (LSOM), Director**
---------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will provide strategic and operational leadership for the country LSOM organization and is accountable for the quality, timeliness, cost, and compliant execution of the country clinical study portfolio. The role achieves results through LSOM Senior Managers and their FTE and FSP teams, translating global clinical development strategy into country operating priorities. The role directs portfolio delivery, resource and capacity strategy, financial planning, quality and risk management, vendor performance, and inspection readiness from feasibility through study close-out. As a member of the country leadership team, this role influences study placement and portfolio decisions, leads the resolution of significant operational issues, develops organizational capability and succession plans, and represents LSOM operations in country, regional, and global governance forums.

 
 

**Accountabilities**

* Lead the successful delivery of the country study portfolio through the LSOM management organization, ensuring alignment with global clinical development priorities.

* Provides strategic direction and leadership to LSOM country organization across the full study lifecycle, including feasibility, study execution, and study close-out.

* Establishes portfolio-level oversight of delivery, quality, risk, timelines, and performance, directing timely escalation and resolution of critical issues for LSOM management organization.

* Manage LSOM and LSOM vendor performance to guarantee high-quality study execution, serving as the primary escalation point for local study challenges, driving solutions, and ensuring portfolio targets are met within the country.

* Build leadership capability within the LSOM organization through targeted coaching, development, and succession planning, preparing LSOMs to lead increasingly complex trials and programs.

* Establishes strong operating partnerships with Clinical Research Associate (CRA) organization to support study start-up, monitoring, issue resolution, and compliant trial execution across the country portfolio.

* Cultivate a high-performing, accountable, and inclusive organization focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

* Champion strong integration between study strategy and local execution teams to translate portfolio priorities into effective country-level delivery.

* Strengthen cross-functional alignment and accountability across country teams to accelerate execution and deliver portfolio commitments.

* Influences study-placement and portfolio investment decisions by providing strategic insight into country's capabilities, operational readiness, performance, and growth potential.

* Anticipates portfolio-level delivery risks, quality trends, and evolving resource requirements, directing mitigation strategies and systemic improvements across country operations.

* Sponsor initiatives that advance operational efficiency, digital innovation, organizational capability, and the adoption of leading practices.

* Direct resource strategy, capacity planning, and workload allocation across FSP and FTE LSOM teams to optimize execution and align resources with global priorities.

* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, GCP, ICH, and organizational standards across the country's study portfolio.

Partner with the Regional Head/Country Head and senior cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, establish accountability for trial deliverables, and resolve significant escalations. 



**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional leader for LSOM Senior Managers and the broader LSOM team, including both FSP and FTE, to optimize trial execution and align with global priorities. including strategy and execution, managing risks and escalations

* Partners closely with CRAs, CSPO, Quality, and FSP partners.

* Leads the coordination among country functional teams to ensure successful delivery of the country portfolio.

* Ensure inspection readiness and provide hands-on support during inspections, including responsibility for storyboards.

* Sponsors continuous operational improvement initiatives and encourage sharing of best practices.

* Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory and quality standards.

* Collaborate with the Regional Head/Country Head to engage cross-functional stakeholders, align on trial deliverables, and manage escalations as needed.

**Capability Building and People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop LSOM Sr Managers, including performance management, succession planning, and leadership bench development.

* Build the organizational capabilities, resourcing needed to meet the current and future regional portfolio requirements.

* Foster a high-performing, inclusive, accountable, and patient-focused culture across geographically distributed teams.

* Lead organizational changes and enable adoption of new operating models, technologies

**Authority**

* Accountable for country level oversight and delivery of clinical trials.

* Manage the performance of LSOM Senior Managers and their teams

* Holds line management authority for regional and country operations leaders, including performance management, talent development, succession planning, and capability building.

* Sets regional delivery goals, operating expectations, and performance standards across study start-up, site engagement, monitoring, execution, and closeout.

* Capability build, talent and performance management, and acting as a liaison for cultural differences within region.

**Outputs**

* Manage LSOM resources in accordance with the global study strategy.

* Oversee resource allocation and workload balance across LSOMs.

* Handle FSP supplier resource coordination and monitor performance through quality oversight metrics.

* Identify and report any risks or compliance concerns related to FSP activities.

* Escalate issues to the Regional/Country Head as necessary.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Doctorate degree and 4 years of clinical research experience OR
* Master’s degree and 7 years of clinical research experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of clinical research experience

* 4 years of direct managerial and/or leadership experience or equivalent

* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead complex cross-functional initiatives within a global matrix organization

* Strong Project Management experience

* Experience managing multiple teams / direct reports across multiple clinical functions / trials

card.description:
**Description**

 
 

WORK LOCATION: Huntsville, AL

FLSA STATUS: Exempt

SALARY RANGE: The anticipated salary range for this role is $152,500 to $231,800 annually. This range reflects a good faith estimate based on the targeted level for the role and typical compensation benchmarks across U.S. locations. Actual compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographical location, and internal alignment.

SUMMARY

The Director of Operations will oversee all aspects of production within the organization, ensuring efficient processes, high-quality output, and adherence to safety and AS9100 quality management standards. This leadership role involves strategic planning, resource management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to optimize production performance and meet business objectives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will have significant experience leading operations within the aerospace, defense, advanced technology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries, with a demonstrated ability to scale operations, improve performance, and support complex product development and production environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The following job functions are a basic requirement but are not limited to and may be assigned other duties.

* Develop and implement operational strategies that align with the company’s goals and objectives, focusing on enhancing production efficiency and reducing costs.
* Manage the entire production process, including scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow optimization, to ensure timely delivery of products while maintaining quality standards.
* Establish and uphold quality assurance protocols to ensure compliance with AS9100 standards, customer requirements, regulatory obligations, and internal quality management system requirements. Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback.
* Identify areas for operational improvement and implement best practices, methodologies (such as Lean or Six Sigma), and technologies to optimize production processes and enhance productivity.
* Drive a culture of quality, operational excellence, accountability, and customer satisfaction throughout the manufacturing organization.
* Work closely with supply chain, engineering, quality assurance, and sales teams to ensure alignment and effective communication regarding production schedules, inventory management, and customer requirements.
* Develop and manage the operations budget, ensuring resources are allocated effectively to support production goals while minimizing waste and controlling costs.
* Promote a safe working environment by ensuring adherence to safety regulations and protocols, conducting training sessions, and addressing any safety concerns promptly.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor production efficiency, quality, and safety. Analyze data and prepare reports for senior management to inform decision-making.
* Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to ensure the timely delivery of materials and components, negotiating contracts and terms to optimize costs and quality.
* Develop contingency plans to address potential disruptions in production, such as equipment failures, supply chain delays, or workforce shortages, ensuring minimal impact on operations.
* Assumes all other responsibilities as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations leadership experience within aerospace, defense, advanced technology, electronics, precision manufacturing, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading complex manufacturing operations supporting government and commercial customers is strongly preferred. Proven track record of successfully managing production processes and driving operational excellence.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace manufacturing principles, AS9100 quality management systems, quality control processes, regulatory compliance requirements, and safety regulations. Demonstrated experience operating within an AS9100-certified manufacturing environment.
* Excellent leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire staff at all levels.
* Proficient in data analysis and performance metrics, with experience using ERP and production management software.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Experience with Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

REDWIRE DEFENSE TECH BENEFITS

* Matching 401(k)
* Paid PTO
* Paid holidays
* Medical, vision, and dental insurance
* Group Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
* HSA and FSA Options
* Critical Care Plan
* Accident Care Plan
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS

This position may require access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). To comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify a US person’s status under the ITAR and the EAR.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The work environment may involve a standard office setting while also incorporating elements of a production area. Employees will use standard office equipment, including computers, and must demonstrate stamina to sit or stand while maintaining attention to detail despite potential interruptions. The role may require occasional activities such as walking, climbing, stooping, crouching, and bending. Vision is necessary for reading printed materials and a computer screen, while hearing and speech are essential for effective communication both in person and over the telephone. Additionally, the position may necessitate travel by air or automobile. Employees may be required to use personal protective equipment, including safety glasses, safety shoes, and shop coats, to ensure safety in the production environment. Employees may be able to lift up to 30 pounds as needed.

REDWIRE DEFENSE TECH IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Redwire Defense Tech is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact Human Resources. Continued employment remains on an “At-Will” basis.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

card.description:
### **The Position**

From the beginning, Genentech has been a team of highly dedicated, passionate individuals. We are a place where people are united around a single purpose and an ambitious vision. Together, we aspire to deliver ever better health outcomes for patients while lowering overall healthcare costs. Our goal is to compel the customer to act on behalf of their patients while showing great commitment to the rare disease community, whose support is key. **Job Description**

**This role is fully remote and must be located within the 50 U.S. states. Standard working hours are in Eastern Timezone. Semi-annual travel may be required to a Devoted office for on-site work.**

**A bit about this role:**

At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family. Devoted is growing at an incredible pace, and we are thrilled to welcome and serve every new member who joins us. This growth demands that our Utilization Management (UM) operation must scale and evolve without ever losing sight of the people at the center of every authorization.

We believe UM done right means decisions that are correct, fair, and fast, delivered through a frictionless process and with heart. Behind every request is a member waiting on care and a provider working to deliver it. UM is hard, but the challenge doesn’t exempt us from our mission.

We are seeking a curious, operationally minded leader to serve as Director, Utilization Management Operations. Reporting to the Vice President of Health Services, you will lead the teams behind our administrative work: a large onshore and offshore team of UM Administrative Coordinators who manage intake, outreach, notifications, and follow-up. You will also hold dotted-line accountability for monitoring and ensuring the success of our Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT).

This role is for someone who is energized by a complex process: someone who wants to unravel it, reimagine it, and lead the build of something simpler, faster, and more consistent. You will have significant influence over the roadmap for Orinoco, our internal technology platform, and an integrated AI engine to put to work. This role will help pave the way towards realizing the next generation of our UM program, driving improvements in effectiveness, efficiency, and experience for our members and provider partners.

**Your Responsibilities and Impact will include**:

* **SLA & Timeliness Ownership:** Own SLA performance for the administrative steps that support authorization review across UM, delivering consistent, predictable performance at a meaningfully lower cost. Hold dotted-line accountability for Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT), partnering with the clinical leaders of that team to monitor performance, surface risks early, and remove administrative barriers to on-time decisions.
* **Process Reimagination:** Map our administrative processes end to end, including auth intake, requests for additional clinical information, facility census checks, member and provider notifications, and member follow-up, and lead their redesign for speed, consistency, and simplicity.
* **Technology & AI Leadership:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the Orinoco roadmap so that process and technology evolve together. Put our integrated AI tools to work to remove manual effort, so our administrative capacity no longer has to grow at the same rate as our membership.
* **Build for Measurement:** Design processes that are highly measurable and transparent by default. Partner with Data Science to define and monitor the KPIs that matter, including timeliness, cost per authorization, quality, and provider experience, and use them to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
* **People & Vendor Leadership:** Lead and develop a team that includes approximately 50 onshore UM Administrative Coordinators and their leaders. Manage our offshore vendor partnership, which supports more than 250 administrative team members, holding it to clear performance standards while building a shared culture of ownership and care.
* **Provider & Member Experience:** Partner with the Provider Network team to understand what providers and facilities need from this process, and build it in. Design every touchpoint, from outreach to notifications to follow-up, with the humans on the other end in mind.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Work closely with the Senior Director of UM, who owns end-to-end authorization performance, along with the UM Medical Directors, Compliance, Provider Network, Data Science, and Engineering teams to keep the operation aligned and consistently audit-ready.

**Required skills and experience:**

* **Mission & Heart:** A genuine commitment to treating members like family, and a belief that operational excellence and empathy belong together.
* **Proven Operator at Scale:** A track record of leading high-volume operations that deliver consistent SLA performance.
* **Builder Mindset:** Experience taking a complex, multi-step process apart and leading the build of a simpler, more scalable one, rather than only maintaining what exists. You are naturally curious and ask why a step exists before deciding how to improve it.
* **Metrics-Oriented:** You build for measurement, are comfortable working deep in the workflows and the data, and use both to drive decisions and hold teams and partners accountable.
* **Technology & AI Curiosity:** Experience partnering with product and engineering teams, and genuine excitement about using AI-enabled tools to transform how work gets done.
* **Vendor Management:** Experience managing vendor partners against clear performance and quality standards.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex problems into actionable updates for leadership and stakeholders.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree required.

**Desired skills and experience**:

* **Healthcare Operations:** Experience in payer operations, utilization management, claims, provider revenue cycle, or a similar high-volume healthcare environment. Prior UM experience is not required.
* **Medicare Advantage Familiarity:** Understanding of Medicare Advantage operations and CMS requirements.
* **Advanced Degree:** MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.
* MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.

card.title: Senior Director, Pharmacovigilance Operations & Compliance
card.description:
Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNA TM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand ( APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit www.veratx.com .

 

 At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney. 

 
 
 
 
 Position Summary: 

 
 
 
 
 This position is responsible for creating, directing, and managing the company’s infrastructure and staff to support the operational aspects of the pharmacovigilance operations and compliance system to adhere to all global regulatory requirements and internal processes and procedures. The qualified candidate will have experience in and perform multiple activities related to overall safety operations strategy across the portfolio, including oversight of case management, database strategy, vendor oversight, compliance, inspection readiness, contracts, departmental strategy and training. In addition, this position must build and maintain relationships with key strategic internal and external stakeholders, including the hiring and development of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance (DSPV) personnel. As a member of the DSPV leadership team, this role partners closely with the Head of DSPV to shape PV Operations strategy, own budget and resourcing decisions, and represent DSPV Operations to senior leadership and external partners.

 
 
 
 
 Responsibilities: 

 
 
 
 
 
 Own and drive global PV Operations strategy, including planning, implementation, and management, in the US and globally internationally, in close alignment with the Head of DSPV on portfolio-level risk, resourcing, and business priorities.

 Serve as a key advisor to the Head of DSPV on operational risk, resource allocation, and DSPV budget planning; own accountability for the DSPV Operations budget, including CRO and vendor contract spend.

 Represent DSPV Operations in interactions with senior leadership and, as needed, and support due diligence activities (e.g., licensing, partnerships, M&A).

 Manage internal and external staff allocated to operational PV activities, creating a highly efficient team.

 Own talent strategy for PV Operations, including hiring, development, performance management, and succession planning.

 Provide expert guidance and leadership both internally and externally based on in-depth knowledge of development and post-marketing safety requirements, per ICH, US and international regulations and guidelines, and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

 Build and implement pharmacovigilance systems that are fully compliant with the applicable worldwide Health Authority PV regulations.

 Provide oversight of systems and MedDRA updates in collaboration with the relevant PV vendor.

 Contribute to the selection of PV vendors to support an outsourced PV business model. Provide vendor oversight and management for all outsourced or insourced PV activities, including establishing and monitoring key quality and compliance metrics, invoicing and budgetary needs related to operations and compliance.

 Develop and implement an inspection readiness program with the contribution of other PV and non-PV stakeholders.

 Serve as the PV Operations lead/host during Health Authority inspections and audits (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA), coordinating responses and remediation.

 Responsible for a compliant and quality execution of all operational activities related to case management and related activities. Oversee timely submissions of expedited reports to the FDA and other health authorities in conjunction with Regulatory.

 Establish a system for identifying, preventing, and correcting compliance deviation, including applicable corrective and preventive actions, in collaboration with the Quality group and internal/external stakeholders, to maintain reporting compliance at the highest level.

 Oversee the setup of new safety projects, including development of study-specific Safety Management Plans and setup of safety systems and database configurations in the PV database to accommodate these trials and products.

 Contribute to, draft, and implement department SOPs and work instructions related to the PV activities.

 Contribute to the signal detection, benefit-risk profile assessment, and aggregate reporting activities with providing accurate reports from the safety database.

 Effectively collaborate with key stakeholders at all levels in the organization, including Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Medical Affairs, and Manufacturing to develop compliant procedures in line with industry standards and best practices.

 Represent PV Operations as a leader on project teams, cross-functional committees, and governance bodies (e.g., Safety Management Team), providing operational input to signal review and safety governance processes.

 Elevate a quality mindset across DSPV.

 Lead training activities, including setting training requirements and training compliance.

 Build and oversee PV regulatory intelligence activities.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 Qualifications: 

 
 
 
 
 
 Healthcare or life sciences degree required; advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, RN, MPH, or scientific PhD) preferred.

 15+ years of pharmacovigilance experience, including 5+ years in a people-leadership role managing global PV teams.

 Experience with clinical and commercial lifecycle phases is required.

 Demonstrated experience managing PV Operations through multiple Health Authority inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA).

 Experience spanning both clinical-stage and commercial/post-marketing environments, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas.

 Skilled in process gap assessments and process enhancements.

 Strategic thinker.

 Strong execution and drive for results skills.

 Comfortable working independently.

 Deep knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines.

 
 
 
 
 Vera Therapeutics Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

 Vera Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

 For this role, the anticipated base pay range is
 $270,000 — $370,000 USD 


 At Vera, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Vera Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays.

 Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Vera Therapeutics through this page. All recruitment vendors (search firms, recruitment agencies, and staffing companies) are prohibited from contacting our hiring manager(s), executive team members, or employees.

 We require that all recruiters and staffing agencies have a fully executed, formal written agreement on file.

card.title: Head of Operations / COO
card.description:
### **About the Role**

Lead day-to-day operations at an early-stage AI company serving manufacturers. You will work closely with the founders to improve customer delivery and build the supplier and freight operations that support the business as it grows.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own customer onboarding, order execution, supplier and carrier coordination, and issue resolution.
* Build the processes, metrics, and playbooks that help a lean team serve more manufacturers.
* Partner with engineering to identify operational workflows for AI automation.
* Manage supplier and freight operations, vendor relationships, and service quality.
* Hire and lead the operations team as the company grows.
* Work with the founders on planning, finance, and company priorities.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Six to ten years of experience, including senior operations leadership as a Head of Operations, COO, VP or Director of Operations, or in a similar role.
* Hands-on experience in supply chain, procurement, logistics, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience at an early-stage startup or on a small team, with the ability to build processes from the ground up and stay hands-on.
* Strong quantitative, systems, and process-design skills.
* Experience in CPG, food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, freight brokerage, or 3PL operations is beneficial, as is experience as a founder or early startup employee.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week. Relocation within the United States is supported.

card.description:
We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Director of Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Operations to lead and optimize our end-to-end CPO operations. This executive leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, quality, profitability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across multiple functions, including demand planning, production and repair operations, new product introduction, customer implementations, service delivery, and product lifecycle management. The ideal candidate is a proven operations leader with experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, or refurbishment environments. This individual will leverage Lean Six Sigma methodologies, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional leadership to deliver scalable processes, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustained business growth.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with occasional travel (~10%).

**What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**

* Lead all aspects of CPO operations, ensuring high levels of quality, service, productivity, and profitability
* Develop and execute short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with business objectives
* Establish policies, procedures, and performance standards that drive operational excellence and accountability
* Oversee demand planning, operations planning and control, production processes, repair operations, parts reclamation, customer implementations, system support, and customer service functions
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma principles and best practices
* Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance programs that improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance customer satisfaction
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering teams to support new product introductions and operational readiness
* Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, improve scalability, and enhance operational performance
* Own operational financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and profitability analysis
* Evaluate business opportunities and operational investments through financial modeling and data-driven analysis
* Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions to achieve business goals
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead high-performing teams
* Establish performance expectations, succession planning, and employee development strategies
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Serve as the primary operational partner for internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Resolve operational, product, system, and customer-related issues while maintaining strong client relationships
* Collaborate across departments to successfully deliver strategic initiatives and operational improvements
* Present recommendations, business cases, and operational updates to leadership teams and executive audiences
* Support the development, launch, and operational integration of new products and services
* Drive ongoing product profitability, compliance, and lifecycle performance
* Partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement innovative solutions that support business growth

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 6+ years of progressive leadership experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, refurbishment, or operations environments
* Strong experience in demand planning, production planning, procurement, materials management, and new product introduction
* Proven success leading process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies
* Advanced analytical and financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance management

card.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the role & team**
-------------------------

We are building a central BU Authenticity Guarantee (AG) Centre of Excellence within eBay’s GFC organisation to strengthen the AG proposition and scale shared capabilities.

 
 

As **Director, AG Strategy & Operations**, you will report to the **GM, Portfolio Strategy & Operations — Global Focus Categories & Live**. You will examine and refine the cross-category strategy, lead and develop a high-performing team, and translate priorities into measurable business outcomes. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strategic judgment, operational understanding, and accountability for delivery—not just recommendations.

 
 

You will work closely alongside category divisions, which own category initiatives and commercial outcomes, and AuthOps, which manages authentication operations.

 
 

**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------

* **AG Strategy & Proposition:** Review and evolve the cross-category AG strategy, customer promise, and shared roadmap. Establish common experience standards and commercial guardrails, balancing consistency with category-specific needs.
* **Business Cases & Investment Prioritisation:** Build clear processes to develop, evaluate, and prioritise cases.Bring together category, finance, product, and AuthOps input to assess customer value, economics, operational feasibility, and expected returns.
* **Hands-On Execution:** Own cross-category initiatives from planning through delivery, with clear achievements and accountability. Spend time in AG centres to understand workflows, customer problems, and operational constraints, translating these insights into practical improvements with category teams and AuthOps.
* **Performance & Scalable Processes:** Establish critical metrics, operating reviews, and reusable launch and expansion playbooks.Track results against arguments, address gaps, and scale successful approaches across categories and markets.
* **People & Cross-Functional Leadership:** Lead and develop the team, aligning partners across category leadership, product, engineering, marketing, AuthOps, and other functions. Resolve dependencies, drive decisions, and communicate clear recommendations and progress to senior leadership.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Strategic & commercial judgment:** Significant experience in strategy, business operations, or general management, with strong business-case development, financial analysis, and investment prioritisation skills.
* **Execution & ownership:** A proven record of turning strategy into measurable results. A hands-on approach to understanding operations, solving problems, and delivering improvements, including willingness to travel to AG centres.
* **People & collaborator leadership:** Demonstrated success developing teams and influencing senior collaborators across business, product, and operations, with clear accountability for outcomes.
* **Analytical & communication skills:** Ability to translate data and customer insights into actionable recommendations and executive-ready communications. Experience in marketplaces, eCommerce, or customer trust is preferred; direct authentication experience is a plus.

**Why join us**
---------------

Help shape AG across eBay, building a team that connects customer trust with commercial growth and delivers improvements across categories and markets.

At eBay, our customers are our compass. We foster a culture where authenticity thrives, bold ideas are encouraged, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work.

**Additional Details**

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$195,200 - $260,600

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guideline.

Director, Executive Protection, Protective Operations and Logistics

The Role:

As the Director of Protective Operations and Logistics within the Executive Protection team, you will be responsible for executive protection program management and logistical planning, including staffing, scheduling*,* protective transportation operations, support request vetting and assessment, training administration, and oversight of the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program. Reporting to the Head of Executive Protection, you will provide operational leadership, program oversight, and subject matter expertise on executive protection and protective operations matters. You willbe responsible for ensuring the effective execution of day-to-day protective operations while supporting the continued enhancement of the firm's executive protection capabilities. The position requires close collaboration with Global Security Operations, the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Travel Security, and key internal and external partners to implement and support Fidelity's executive protection strategy. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational, leadership, and relationship-management skills, as well as the ability to balance competing priorities while delivering consistent, discreet, and service-oriented experience for Fidelity's senior leadership.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

* 7-10 years of experience protecting C-suite executives, board members, and/or government officials in complex, dynamic, and globally distributed operating environments within corporate, government, military, or law enforcement settings.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple workstreams
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, security professionals, and external stakeholders
* Extensive knowledge of executive protection operations, including protective advances, travel security, transportation security, venue assessment, route planning and protective operations logistics.
* Expertise in assessing, prioritizing, and coordinating executive support requests while balancing risk, resource requirements, and business priorities.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required and operate effectively in dynamic, rapidly changing, and high-pressure environments.

* Demonstrated ability to manage executive protection staffing models, personnel scheduling, resource allocation, and operational readiness across multiple locations and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, develop, and build high-performing teams while fostering a culture of professionalism, accountability, discretion, and service excellence.
* Experience coordinating and supporting executive travel, special events, corporate meetings, and other high-visibility engagements requiring detailed planning and collaboration.
* Experience managing executive transportation programs, including vehicle operations, driver standards, fleet utilization, and transportation security protocols.
* Experience developing and managing executive protection training programs, operational exercises, performance standards, readiness assessments, and professional development initiatives.
